note: Prompts for exercising PLAN + QUOTE without spend. `expected_intent` is the classification a correct agent makes; `expected_allocation_4` / `expected_allocation_8` are the ordered lists of model ids the deterministic Advisor produces at count=4 and count=8 against the CURRENT reference files (model-catalog.yaml + generation-policy.md + arena-scores.yaml). count=4 stays on two models (A + B); count=8 widens to a third surviving model C, subject to the provider-diversity guardrail in _secondary()/_tertiary().
